title: Comments at Scale

gdocs-summary.caption: A user asks Gemini in the side panel which issues in the comments still need resolving. The answer groups points by theme and attributes each to a reviewer by name.
gdocs-summary.detail: Each point names the reviewer it came from and carries a numbered reference.

gdocs-ai-comments.caption: Gemini drafts a comment for the user to post ("AI comments 1 of 2"), shown in the normal comment rail with Cancel and Comment buttons.
gdocs-ai-comments.detail: AI-drafted comments are paged ("1 of 2") and only post when the user clicks Comment.

gdocs-draft-changes.caption: Gemini rewrites a paragraph to address reviewer comments, shown as tracked changes with Accept all and Reject all.
gdocs-draft-changes.detail: Edits appear as tracked changes; Accept all and Reject all act on the whole set.

gdocs-video.caption: From Google's launch video: Gemini replying inside open comment threads next to a chart in a Doc.
gdocs-video.detail: Replies are drafted inside the existing comment threads.

confluence-summary.caption: The "Comment summary" card at the top of the comments panel. Each bullet names the commenter and ends in numbered citations that jump to the source comments.
confluence-summary.detail: Every bullet ends in numbered citation chips that link to the source comments.

confluence-filters.caption: The comments panel filter menu: Open, Unread, Resolved, sort order, inline vs. all comments, plus "Mark all as read" and "Mark all as resolved".
confluence-filters.detail: Bulk actions (mark all read, mark all resolved) sit in the same menu as the filters.

word-copilot-tabs.caption: The Copilot Summary at the top of a Word doc, with tabs for Summary, Insights, Activity, Discussion and Coaching, and a Brief/Standard/Detailed length control.
word-copilot-tabs.detail: Comments have their own Discussion tab; summary length is adjustable.

figma-agent-summary.caption: Figma's agent answers "Can you summarize the comments on this page?" with 12 comments grouped into Scope Questions, Design Feedback and Pending Confirmation.
figma-agent-summary.detail: One category is a status (Pending Confirmation), not a topic.

figjam-sort.caption: Sort stickies: FigJam AI copies the selected stickies and groups them by theme into new sections.
figjam-sort.detail: Sorting works on a copy; the original stickies stay in place.

figjam-summary.caption: Summarize stickies: FigJam AI creates a new summary object on the board next to the source notes.
figjam-summary.detail: The summary is a new object on the canvas rather than a chat reply.

frameio-filters.caption: Comment filters for annotations, attachments, completed/incomplete, unread, mentions, hashtag and person.
frameio-filters.detail: Hashtag and Person are filter dimensions alongside status.

frameio-export.caption: Copy, print or export comments to editing tools (FCP, Premiere, Resolve) or CSV/TXT. The note reads: "Only visible comments, including filtered and searched, will be copied and exported."
frameio-export.detail: The menu states that only visible (filtered or searched) comments are copied and exported.

tableau-comments.caption: The comments pane on a published dashboard. A comment carries a snapshot of the filtered view it refers to.
tableau-comments.detail: The comment carries a snapshot of the filtered view it refers to.

drive-catchup.caption: Clicking "Catch me up" on Drive home opens a Gemini panel that summarizes what changed across files since yesterday, including decisions and open questions.
drive-catchup.detail: Suggested follow-up prompts appear under the summary.

drive-badge.caption: A sparkle badge next to a file name means it has new changes or comments since your last visit. Clicking it summarizes that file.
drive-badge.detail: Unread state shows per file in the list, before opening anything.

productboard-spark.caption: A proactive Spark card: "Spark has something for you…" with an Opportunity theme backed by 89 notes from 12 customers.
productboard-spark.detail: The theme shows its evidence count: 89 notes from 12 customers.

github-batch.caption: A suggested change in a review comment with "Commit suggestion" and "Add suggestion to batch".
github-batch.detail: Batched suggestions become one commit with each suggester as co-author.

copilot-review-comment.caption: A Copilot review comment flagged High, with a suggested changeset and Apply suggestion / Add suggestion to batch.
copilot-review-comment.detail: AI comments use the same Apply / Add to batch controls as human suggestions, plus a severity tag.

copilot-fix-mobile.caption: "Copilot's findings" on a PR in GitHub Mobile, with a Fix with Copilot button that hands the comments to the cloud agent.
copilot-fix-mobile.detail: The Fix with Copilot button sits directly under the findings summary.

bugbot-autofix.caption: Bugbot reports it found an issue and that Autofix already prepared a fix, with Create PR, a push command and a preview.
bugbot-autofix.detail: The fix exists before anyone asks; the person chooses Create PR or push.

vercel-cli.caption: "vercel comments" lists unresolved preview comments for the branch; "inspect" shows the thread with the exact DOM element it was pinned to.
vercel-cli.detail: Output includes the DOM element each comment was pinned to.

linear-inbox.caption: The Triage inbox, where unplanned work from Intercom, Sentry and people lands in one queue.
linear-inbox.detail: Items from Intercom, Sentry and people share one queue.

linear-triage-intel.caption: Suggestions for assignee, project and label, plus "Duplicate of" and "Related to" links.
linear-triage-intel.detail: Suggestions sit in their own module, apart from fields set by people.
linear-triage-intel.short: AI suggestions in their own module

linear-guidance.caption: "Additional guidance": plain-language rules that steer triage suggestions, e.g. "All billing-related issues should use the Stripe label."
linear-guidance.detail: Guidance is plain-language text at the workspace level.

linear-rule.caption: A deterministic rule that runs after the AI: When customer tier includes Enterprise, set priority to Urgent.
linear-rule.detail: Rules run after Triage Intelligence has made its suggestions.

coderabbit-learning.caption: A maintainer corrects CodeRabbit in a PR thread. CodeRabbit replies and adds a Learning, recording who it learned from, the PR, file, timestamp and the rule.
coderabbit-learning.detail: Each learning records who it came from, the PR, file and lines, and when.

coderabbit-dashboard.caption: The Learnings dashboard: totals, active in 30 days, never used, with usage counts and last-used dates per learning, plus CSV export.
coderabbit-dashboard.detail: Each learning shows a usage count and last-used date; the header counts "never used".

bugbot-rule.caption: A learned rule ("New Datadog service monitors must be owned by the service team"), tagged Learned Rule, with an Enabled toggle and editable content.
bugbot-rule.detail: Rules are tagged Learned Rule, have an Enabled toggle and editable text.

bugbot-loop.caption: Bugbot's learning loop: emoji reactions, replies and PR comments feed candidate rules that get created, promoted or disabled across repo and team scopes.
bugbot-loop.detail: Inputs include emoji reactions, replies and PR comments.

bugbot-chart.caption: Cursor's chart of resolution rate (share of flagged bugs fixed by merge) climbing from Aug 2025 to Apr 2026 while bugs found per run also went up. Cursor reports 52% at launch and 78% now.
bugbot-chart.detail: Cursor uses resolution rate as the outcome metric for learning.

genie-monitor.caption: The Monitor tab: every question with its rating, review request, comment and user, filterable by time, conversation type, rating and status.
genie-monitor.detail: Ratings, review requests and comments are columns in one filterable table.

genie-digest.caption: Weekly digest of questions, users, thumbs up and down, with the Analyze Space Usage button that launches an agent review.
genie-digest.detail: "Analyze Space Usage" launches an agent review of the week.

genie-benchmarks.caption: Benchmark runs with accuracy per run, and a "Manual review needed" status where no ground-truth SQL exists.
genie-benchmarks.detail: Runs without ground-truth SQL are marked "Manual review needed".

genie-eval.caption: One benchmark result: model SQL next to ground-truth SQL, an assessment of Good, and Update ground truth.
genie-eval.detail: Model SQL and ground-truth SQL are shown side by side.

hex-dashboard.caption: Context Studio overview: conversations, users and warnings over time, top conversation topics, and a table of threads with flags like Missing context and User doubt.
hex-dashboard.detail: Warnings are charted against conversation topics.

hex-topics.caption: Threads listed with user, role, prompt and an AI-extracted topic.
hex-topics.detail: Each thread gets an AI-extracted topic.

hex-inspector.caption: The read-only Thread Inspector: the agent's reasoning and table, plus a summary panel of what happened.
hex-inspector.detail: The inspector is read-only for admins.

hex-warning.caption: A User doubt warning ("User pushed back on how the agent segmented customers…") with "Fix with Suggestion: Clarify customer sector segments".
hex-warning.detail: The warning links straight to a suggested fix.

hex-suggestions.caption: The Suggestions feed in Context Studio: drafted context changes such as Define B2B account reporting rules and Clarify fiscal calendar conventions, each with an evidence count.
hex-suggestions.detail: Suggestions are listed as rows with a status (Open) and age.

hex-diff.caption: An accepted suggestion shown as a diff to a workspace guide (fiscal year logic), with Reject and Publish per file.
hex-diff.detail: Each changed guide file has its own Reject and Publish.

hex-preview.caption: Before publishing, a Thread Preview runs a test question ("When does our fiscal calendar start?") against the staged changes.
hex-preview.detail: A test question runs against staged changes before publishing.

hex-loop.caption: Hex's diagram: threads, notebooks, Slack/MCP feed Context Studio, where a Review Agent produces suggestions that update workspace context.
hex-loop.detail: A Review Agent sits between thread observability and context updates.

spotter-review-terms.caption: Review business terms: each phrase in a question is mapped to search tokens, with approve and reject controls per mapping.
spotter-review-terms.detail: Each phrase-to-token mapping is approved or rejected on its own.

spotter-fix-term.caption: Fix business term: "revenue" mapped to Amount booked in the Salesforce model.
spotter-fix-term.detail: The correction is saved as a business term in the model.

langsmith-bulk.caption: Select threads in bulk and add them to an annotation queue from the bottom action bar.
langsmith-bulk.detail: The selection in the threads table becomes the queue batch.
langsmith-bulk.short: Bulk add threads to a queue

langsmith-queue.caption: The queue reviewer: item list with Needs Review / Needs Others' Review / Completed, the transcript, and a rubric feedback pane.
langsmith-queue.detail: Each item has a review status, including "Needs Others' Review".

langsmith-pairwise.caption: Two runs side by side with A / B / Equal buttons and keyboard shortcuts.
langsmith-pairwise.detail: Reviewers choose A, B or Equal, with keyboard shortcuts.

mlflow-session.caption: Create Labeling Session: pick a dataset, choose label schemas, and preview the questions experts will answer.
mlflow-session.detail: Label schemas define the questions reviewers answer.

mlflow-assess.caption: A trace with expert assessments: a No rating with written rationale, and an expected summary as ground truth.
mlflow-assess.detail: A written rationale is stored next to the rating.
